bio.text: John McGuire is serving his first term in the U.S. House of Representatives for Virginia's 5th Congressional District, according to his House website.
He served 10 years in the U.S. Navy as a Navy SEAL and then founded a fitness business, SEAL Team PT, Inc., in Central Virginia.
He was elected to the Virginia House of Delegates in 2018 and later to the Virginia State Senate, and he lives in Goochland, Virginia.
